turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How would you calculate seven-day retained users in SQL?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I would define the cohort date, join later activity on user_id, and count distinct users active on day seven.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: If retained users improved after a product change, what would stop you from calling that causal?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Seasonality, selection effects, concurrent launches, and instrumentation changes could all confound the comparison.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How would you present the result to a product lead?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I would separate observed lift from causal claims, show uncertainty, and state the decision-relevant caveats.
